text_block_list.text:
One day, Furioso was feeling unwell, so I 
decided to have her rest in the 
infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the trouble. I'll get 
plenty of rest and get back in shape.
choice_data_list: Yeah, make sure to get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Matches, would anyone like to buy some 
matches...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I'm in a hurry. Go ask someone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...None of them are selling. If I go back 
like this, I'll get chewed out again.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's so cold... My vision is getting 
blurry... A-At this rate... it'll end just 
like... that story I've read since I was 
little—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, getting scolded is inevitable. 
Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait up, you jerk! Why are you trying 
to go home?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: And you are...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
An angel, you're an angel! I've been 
waiting forever for you to strike a match!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Here, it's freezing, right? Just go all 
out and use it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is merchandise for sale. We can't 
just use it as we please.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Guh, true... wait, no! God told me to 
bring you up to heaven once you spend all 
that!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
God? Heaven? I haven't the faintest idea 
what you're talking about.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp! Could it be matchmakers from the 
URA? Are they trying to sabotage our 
sales?!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Why do you have to be like that?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I won't yield to such business 
interference. I'll show you that I can 
sell every last one of these matches!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Would anyone like some matches! If you 
light the firewood, you'll be able to stay 
warm!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I just ran out of those. Could I have 
one?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Our feelings finally got through! 
Alright, let's keep this momentum 
going...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What the hell are you doing, hey?! This is 
your chance to live happily in paradise, 
you know?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Obstacles are bound to accompany the 
achievement of goals, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Very well, this is a serious contest. I 
will sell every last match!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, obstacles are meant to be overcome. 
I will leap over them...!"

Waking from her dream, Furioso regained 
her energy like a completely new horse 
girl!
